#  11924 - Plasma Physics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11924 - module is no longer offered from SS 2022**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Plasma Physics**  |  
|  Plasmaphysik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. habil. Mussenbrock, Thomas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students know the fundamental physical phenomena in plasmas. They understand basic aspects of the single particle and fluid description of plasmas, as well as basic principles of kinetic plasma theory. The students have gained knowledge of important applications of plasmas, e.g., controlled fusion and materials processing.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Definition of the plasma state
  * Single particle motion in electric and magnetic fields
  * Stochastic processes in plasmas
  * Fluid description of plasmas
  * Waves in plasmas
  * Kinetic description of plasmas
  * Plasma boundaries
  * Applications of plasmas

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of the topics of modules
  * 11107: Mathematics - T1
  * 11108: Mathematics - T2
  * 11206: Mathematics - T3
  * 11468: Theory of Electrical Engineering - Electrostatics
  * 13304: Structure of Matter: Atoms, Molecules, Solids

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * A. Piel, Plasma Physics, Springer
  * J.A. Bittencourt, Introduction to Plasma Physics, Springer
  * F.F. Chen, Introduction to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion, Springer

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * oral examination, 45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Physics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Physical Specialization with Theoretical Focus“, topic area „Theory, Simulation and further topics“

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Plasma Physics - lecture
  * Plasma Physics - exercise
  * Plasma Physics - exams

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
